propositions: An optional, isolated GitHub Actions adapter must parse coverage percentage from pytest-cov log output and CI-health metadata (status, duration, red-green recovery interval, flake rate) from GHA run history.

The harvester script must read recent test.yml run logs and metadata via the GHA API, pass them through the adapter, and persist labeled snapshots to the tracked .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson store, not to gitignored reports/.
The core metrics modules (registry.py, __init__.py) and future metrics command must not import the GHA adapter to preserve portability and isolation.

Coverage is extracted by anchored word-boundary grep on the pytest-cov TOTAL line from run-log tail; no workflow modifications are required since coverage is already emitted by the existing pytest-cov step.
Snapshots must carry source labels (e.g., source=snapshot or CI-health-specific labels) to sit in the going-forward time series.

Unit tests must verify fixture log parsing yields expected coverage percentage (84.2%), two fixture runs (fail then pass) yield correct red-green recovery duration, and persistence writes to the correct tracked store path.
